verdict.rationale: Warp documents a REST API that exposes company payroll data and an MCP connection so agents like Claude or ChatGPT can use Warp. That covers an agent pulling payroll data, but nothing shows payroll journal entries, GL/journal exports, or any reconciliation into an accounting ledger. Missing for 10: a documented payroll journal/GL endpoint or export, ledger or accounting-system integration, reconciliation workflow, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payroll journal data via API or export and reconcile the entries into my ledger

citations.quote: The Warp API lets you build custom apps and integrations that use your company's HR, payroll, time off, workplace, and department data.
Use Warp from the agents your team already runs. Claude, ChatGPT, and any client that speaks MCP.
